truth_rules.current_selector: This file alone selects live operational state.
truth_rules.implementation_facts: Use live repository, PR, CI, filesystem, and tool evidence.
truth_rules.legacy_surfaces: Legacy selectors are compatibility projections or history only and may not override this file.
truth_rules.cross_program_successor_rule: Before successor selection, consult governance/application-planning/ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json. Individual program strict_successor or backlog fields cannot skip an eligible interstitial program or override cross-program gates.
truth_rules.executor_independence: Executor availability never grants or revokes project authority.
truth_rules.parallel_lane_rule: MSAS, MRCS and MVPS are independent persistent implementation lanes and may hold authority concurrently. Lane selection is per conversation; work in one lane does not pause, revoke, reorder or rewrite another. Same-repository publication remains serialized by the OPS3 FIFO reservation queue.
truth_rules.protected_main_interlock: For cybalicistjt-stack/Multiversal-app and cybalicistjt-stack/multiversal-aioc, every main mutation participates in the repository-local FIFO queue. Direct main writes are prohibited. Once a turn activates, target main is frozen at turn_base for all other lanes/executors; unexpected advancement is OPS3.PROTECTED_MAIN_BYPASS and must be diagnosed rather than normalized by holder rebase/yield/re-reserve.
truth_rules.persistent_execution_lanes: OPS3 preserves exactly three independent persistent implementation lanes: msas, mrcs and mvps. UISR-11 is completed program history and does not occupy a persistent implementation slot.
truth_rules.active_turn_liveness: Protected-main publication turns carry bounded material-progress liveness. A stale active turn cannot merge or cosmetically renew; it must be recovery-released or stalled-turn recovered according to scripts/ops3_merge_lease.py.
truth_rules.no_progress_loop: Repeated owner execution commands with unchanged material_progress_seq are OPS3.NO_MATERIAL_PROGRESS and require stall diagnosis/recovery before another ordinary execution cycle.
truth_rules.generated_main_writers: CI/bots/generated-content jobs may not push directly to protected main; generated outputs must be present on the queue-bound candidate branch or validation fails closed.

next_project_action: Continue only the persistent implementation lane explicitly requested by the owner. MSAS-03 is selected_not_started, MRCS-01 remains independently in_progress, and MVPS-10 remains independently selected_not_started; same-repository publication stays FIFO-serialized.
